Every year, federal workers generously donate millions through the Combined Federal Campaign, the world’s largest workplace giving program. Now, the Trump Administration wants to shut down this lifeline for countless charities.

Let’s work to save the CFC for the sick kids, hungry families and students with disabilities who depend on it.


The Banner Montgomery (@bannermoco)

The Trump Administration is using its unlawful closure of the Kennedy Center as a pretext for illegally firing dozens of unionized workers there. Trump can no more rename this the “Trump-Kennedy Center” than he can rename its neighbor the “Trump-Lincoln Memorial.” These institutions exist in law as do the bargaining and workplace rights of the Kennedy Center’s excellent staff. The courts must respond. nytimes.com/2026/05/04/arts/…

“Dare to struggle, dare to win”—a famous refrain in the Civil Rights Movement of the last century. We too dare to struggle and dare to win in our time. Our Constitution and Amendments are a record of the struggles of our people for a more perfect Union.

I was honored to join the @BrennanCenter and hundreds of true-blue patriots to celebrate and defend the progress of multi-racial, multi-ethnic American democracy against the authoritarians and white supremacists.

Trump said, “Not one penny is being used from the federal government” to fund his ballroom boondoggle. True, in the sense that $1 billion is a lot more than one penny! Another GOP billion-dollar bailout for the gaudy gilded king, paid for courtesy of the American commoners—the rest of us minus the billionaires who pay no taxes.


Peter Nicholas (@Petereporter)

This antisemitic graffiti at Greenwood Elementary School in Brookeville is profoundly disturbing. We’re all holding the students and Greenwood community close as authorities continue to investigate another intolerable act of antisemitic vandalism.

This week's MD-08 Local Hero is the talented Director of MoCo's Department of Transportation, Christopher Conklin.

Yesterday, MoCo unveiled the nation's largest transit depot electrical grid. Chris joined us to share what this impressive green project means for transit in our community. piped.video/watch?v=OOq4LYTq…

The violent lawlessness Netanyahu's government is fomenting in the West Bank has lethal consequences for innocent people. This month, 14-year-old Aws al-Naasan and 32-year-old Jihad Abu Naim were killed in an attack on a school in the village of al-Mughayyir. We owe it to them to pursue accountability, peace and dramatic changes to this untenable situation. bbc.com/news/articles/cp864d…
Congrats to Montgomery County for building the nation’s largest transit depot electrical grid! Thank you for leading the way in pioneering cleaner energy solutions for transit in our community.

The House GOP finally caved in to reality and joined House Democrats, Senate Democrats and Senate Republicans in voting to fund the rest of DHS except for the dangerously lawless ICE and Border Patrol.

Why did Speaker Johnson make hardworking FEMA officials, TSA and Secret Service agents and other federal workers wait more than two months to receive their regular paychecks?

As President Trump spends billions of dollars for his aggressive and foolish war of choice in Iran, congressional Republicans are handing him billions more to fund ICE chaos in our communities. 

The GOP has a destructive agenda.

The American people don’t want the oligarchs’ war in Iran and ICE’s war in our streets. We want affordable health care for every family.

Who exactly are President Trump and Speaker Johnson fighting for? Not us.

President Trump doesn't care whether you can afford health care, rent or groceries. He has no plan for America’s working families. Instead, the president fills his time settling political scores and litigating beach sea shell messages from nine months ago.

Video

In the Callais decision, the Roberts Court just completed its effective demolition of the Voting Rights Act of 1965. The new MAGA double standard is that the deliberate destruction of a majority-African American or Hispanic district is perfectly permissible as a “partisan gerrymander,” but the deliberate creation of a majority-African American or Hispanic district is an impermissible “racial gerrymander.” The pro-MAGA majority has capsized the will of Congress and gutted the Voting Rights Act.

Those of us at the dinner on Saturday were made safe because of the large number of dedicated Secret Service agents and other law enforcement officials tasked with securing the venue. But what about the tens of thousands of Americans who are subject to gun violence at work, the movies, the grocery store, on college campuses and at school? We need a national conversation about the common-sense gun law reforms favored by the vast majority of our people.

We gathered to honor the difficult life of an extraordinary woman, Virginia Roberts Giuffre.

Virginia became a fierce voice for justice, who organized an irreversible reckoning in America with the organized sexual abuse of girls and young women by men and women who have power over them. May Virginia’s sparkling memory be a blessing to her family and her nation.

In honor of National Poetry Month, this week's Local Hero is the ebullient Sosena Audain, Montgomery County's 2026 Youth Poet Laureate. We celebrate Sosena’s wonderfully creative artistry. Please listen in as she shares a live reading of one of her moving poems. piped.video/watch?v=KT7phNWs…

The world is demanding freedom for Peyvand Naimi, an athlete facing unjust imprisonment, torture and potential execution by the increasingly hard-line Iranian regime in Iran. Naimi has been targeted and scapegoated because of his Baha'i faith and coerced into false confessions. The Iranian regime must release Naimi immediately.
